# TolTECA tutorials

> Runnable user workflows, ecosystem teaching material, and workshops.

This is a fresh v3 collection on codex/v3-learning-materials. The previous
collection remains on the archive branch, currently main; its content and
dependencies are not part of this branch. Record the checkout revision, the
environment lock, and each dataset manifest when using a recipe.

## Start and run

- [Quick start](README.md): Clone, install the locked environment, and run JupyterLab.
- [Reference data](datasets/README.md): Pair with a separate tolteca_ref_data checkout; inputs are read-only.
- [Data manifest](datasets/reference.toml): Upstream revision and exact starter file identity.
- [Workflows](workflows/README.md): Runnable starter and planned scientific workflows.
- [Inspect reference data](workflows/inspect-reference-data/README.md): Verify the environment and one telescope file; this is not a complete reduction recipe.
- [Validation record](workflows/inspect-reference-data/validation.md): Exercised environment and limits.

## Teaching material

- [Presentations](presentations/README.md): Ecosystem and workflow teaching decks; collection initially empty.
- [Workshops](workshops/README.md): Teaching sequences with slides and exercises; collection initially empty.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Source ownership and validation requirements.

Package-owned guides remain authoritative for software interfaces. Read
architecture specifications and review decks in the owning package repository
with their revision and evidence. Proposed behavior is not a supported recipe.
